subject: electrical-technology
general_outcomes: By the end of Senior School, the learner should be able to:
Observe personal safety, safety of tools, equipment and machines in the practice of electrical engineering works.
Analyse, design, and construct electric circuits.
Troubleshoot and fix faults in electrical and electronic systems.
Apply appropriate communication skills across varied settings and audiences in interpretation of Electrical Engineering works.
Practise good citizenship in waste management and ethical use of electronic and electrical technology.
Adhere to the established standards and regulations in Electrical Technology to uphold professional and ethical practices.
Utilise acquired skills, knowledge and attitude for career growth and further education and training in electrical engineering.
Appreciate electrical technology in the socio-economic development of the country.
